candidates.explanation: The component directly accesses the `EcosiaAuthenticationService.shared` singleton to retrieve `isLoggedIn` and `userProfile` properties, creating a hard-coded dependency on a global service rather than receiving it through a replaceable dependency boundary.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: Visible global static shared instance providing access to the mutable state.

candidates.explanation: The `EcosiaAuthUIStateProvider` class contains a static `shared` property that provides access to a mutable instance state (via the `@Published` properties of the class) from a global context without visible synchronization or actor isolation for its external access.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation

evidence.description: Use of `nonisolated(unsafe)` on a static variable.
Multiple concurrent access points to the unsafe static variable.

candidates.explanation: The property `seedProgressManagerType` is declared as a `nonisolated(unsafe)` static variable and is accessed from multiple concurrency contexts (e.g., in `handleSeedProgressUpdate`, `resetToLocalSeedCollection`, and `handleLocalSeedCollection`) without any visible safety invariants or synchronization.
candidates.title: Unjustified Unsafe Concurrency Escape Hatch
